# Analytics Glossary

## Metrics

- **MRR** - Monthly Recurring Revenue
- **ARR** - Annual Recurring Revenue
- **CAC** - Customer Acquisition Cost
- **LTV** - Customer Lifetime Value
- **Churn Rate** - Customer cancellation percentage
- **ARPU** - Average Revenue Per User

## Datasets

- **Customer Orders** - Transactional order data
- **Billing Transactions** - Raw billing system logs
- **Marketing Attribution** - Touchpoint attribution data

## Related Concepts

See [Metrics](../metrics/index.md) and [Datasets](../datasets/index.md) for detailed definitions.
